verdict.rationale: The evidence shows plan changes, proration and subscription edits only through Orb's merchant-facing web UI or its API. There is no evidence of a customer-facing hosted portal or embeddable components that let end customers upgrade, downgrade or cancel on their own. The 'self-serve' agent-pricing doc describes a token top-up pricing model, not a customer portal, so building self-serve would mean custom work on the API.
